name: Helvio Carvalho Junior
biography: Helvio is the CEO of Sec4US, a leading company in Cyber Security, and stands out as a renowned researcher in the field. He made history by being the first in Latin America to achieve the prestigious OSCE3 certification, a milestone that reflects his deep knowledge and technical skill. With over 23 years of experience across various segments of Information Technology, Helvio currently focuses on research in bypass techniques for Endpoint Detection and Antivirus solutions, as well as specializing in offensive information security (RedTeam). His passion for creating exploits and malware is well-known and significantly contributes to the advancement of cybersecurity.
